name: Osage Farm
tagline: Freshly Grown Produce in Rabun Gap, GA
description: A working pumpkin patch in 030 Hwy. 441 North, GA, Osage Farm grows Pumpkins, Corn, Peas, and Honey. The patch is busiest in autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
